summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Epic E5 Admin Backoffice. All core features tested successfully including admin login, RBAC, dashboard, product CRUD with live preview, categories, vouchers, orders, reviews moderation, and settings with 5 tabs.
passed_tests: Admin login at /admin with correct credentials (admin@collectorparfum.id)
RBAC: Customer login correctly rejected with 'Akses ditolak' message and redirect to storefront
Dashboard loaded with 4 metrics (revenue, orders, products=12, reviews)
Dashboard shows recent orders section and low stock section
Products list page with 12 products, search input, and status filter
Product CREATE: Successfully created new product 'Test Parfum E5 Automation'
Product editor Info tab: Name, brand, category, concentration, gender, status fields working
Product editor Varian tab: Added 2 variants (50ml/250000/10 stock, 100ml/450000/5 stock)
Product editor Media tab: Successfully added media URL and displayed in gallery
Product editor SEO tab: SEO title input working with character counter
Live preview pane visible and updating with product data
Product save successful with toast notification 'Produk dibuat'
Product search functionality working
Categories page accessible with 6 categories displayed (Amber & Oud, Citrus, Floral, Fresh Aquatic, Gourmand, Woody)
Category add button present
Vouchers page accessible with vouchers table
Voucher add button present
Orders page accessible (empty state handled correctly with 'Belum ada pesanan')
Orders status filter dropdown present
Reviews page accessible with reviews table showing multiple reviews
Reviews status filter working
Reviews moderation buttons (Tayangkan/Sembunyikan) present
Settings page accessible with all 5 tabs
Settings Toko tab: 7 input fields (store name, currency, email, phone, COD fee, free shipping threshold, low stock threshold)
Settings Toko tab: Save button present
Settings Kurir tab: Shipping methods table with add button
Settings Pembayaran tab: Payment methods table showing 8 methods (Transfer BCA, BNI, Mandiri, ShopeePay, OVO, GoPay, DANA, COD)
Settings Pembayaran tab: Add payment button present
Settings Media tab: Media library grid with 4 images, URL input and add button working
Settings Pengguna tab: Users table showing admin@collectorparfum.id and customer@collectorparfum.id
Mobile responsive menu button working
Theme toggle button working
Navigation sidebar with all menu items
Breadcrumb navigation working
Admin shell layout rendering correctly
